tests.name: Remote OpenClaw baseline is healthy
tests.expected_result: The proving lane runs the approved OpenClaw baseline and passes routine runtime verification.

tests.name: QMD sidecar memory is enabled
tests.expected_result: QMD is installed on the host, selected as the memory backend, and reachable from the baseline runtime.

tests.name: Memory stays light
tests.expected_result: Memory retrieval uses tight limits so the default local model is not flooded with irrelevant prompt context.

tests.name: Orchestrator routes before memory injection
tests.expected_result: The default assistant decides whether memory, web, coding, or escalation is required before invoking the heavier path.

tests.name: Web baseline works without browser
tests.expected_result: Web search and fetch support the default assistant while browser remains outside the baseline.

tests.name: OpenAI escalation is available
tests.expected_result: Harder reasoning and coding tasks can escalate from the local default model to OpenAI-backed execution.

tests.name: Baseline specialist agents exist
tests.expected_result: Coding, research, and management-oriented agents are available with bounded responsibilities.

tests.name: Dev-to-test loop is repeatable
tests.expected_result: Changes can be deployed, validated, inspected, and backed out on the proving lane using official Moltbox surfaces.
